metadata.title: Dokkan Battle Modern Meta Tactical Dictionary (Post-10th Anniversary)
metadata.description: Comprehensive tactical keyword ontology, slot viability rules, and incremental effect tracking for Qwen team generation.

order_of_operations_damage_formula.formula: {[(Enemy_ATK x Variance x Type_Modifier) x (1 - Damage_Reduction)] - Ally_DEF} x Guard_Reduction

mechanics_explanation.damage_reduction: Applied FIRST to Enemy ATK. Multiplicative scaling makes DR mathematically superior at higher boss attack stats.
mechanics_explanation.defense_stat: Subtracted SECOND after DR has reduced the incoming ATK. A unit with 500k DEF facing 3M ATK with 50% DR takes (1.5M - 500k) = 1M before guard.
mechanics_explanation.guard_reduction: Applied LAST as a 0.5x multiplier on the remaining post-DEF value. Also locks Type Modifier to 0.8x if passive guard.
mechanics_explanation.critical_takeaway: Naked guard (0% DR) is INSUFFICIENT for Slot 1 against 2.5M+ Boss Super Attacks. Slot 1 requires either Guard + DR (>= 40-50%) or massive raw DEF (> 1M) or high evasion (>= 70%).

slot_1_tank.role: Absorbs pre-attack Super Attacks before the rotation has attacked.
prerequisites: Must have pre-attack Guard (Unconditional or active at turn start)
Or pre-attack Evasion >= 70% with fallback defense
fatal_traps: Card whose guard only triggers 'As the 2nd or 3rd attacker in a turn' (e.g. LR Gogeta post-turn 3, Supreme Kai)
Card whose defense multiplies only 'When attacking' or 'When performing a Super Attack'
Card relying purely on on-hit or on-super stacking before building up
Expired intro shield (e.g. Turn 5 onwards for a 3-turn intro unit)

slot_2_anchor.role: Main damage dealer and linker. Shielded from pre-attack slot 1 supers; benefits from post-attack DEF boosts and builds attack/defense stacks safely.
prerequisites: High post-attack DEF multiplier ('When attacking', 'When performing a Super Attack')
Multiple Super Attacks ('Launches an additional Super Attack')
Critical hit chance and Type Effectiveness

slot_3_floater.role: Rotates every 3 turns. Brings teamwide support, scouter intelligence, or high dodge without hogging Ki or requiring high link synergy.
prerequisites: Support passive: Allies' Ki +1..3 and DEF +30..50%
High evasion (>= 70%) or 3rd slot evasion buff

permanent_stacking.definition: Stat buffs that persist for 99 turns (infinite stacking). Crucial for long battles (Red Zone / Supreme Magnificent Battle 4+ phases).

types.value: +20% to +30% to SA multiplier per Super Attack
+50% to SA multiplier per Super Attack
+10% to +30% ATK & DEF per attack performed/received up to cap
+5% to +10% DR per attack received/performed up to cap

intro_cliff_effect.definition: Temporary buffs active 'For X turns from character's entry turn'. Once expired, the card experiences a sharp defensive drop.
intro_cliff_effect.tactical_rule: On Turn 5, if the fight is not over, rotate the unit out to Slot 2 or Slot 3 unless it has permanent stacks or transformed!

slot_2_3_conditional_lock.definition: Skills explicitly requiring the unit to be 2nd or 3rd attacker in a turn to receive Guard or DR.
